INSERT INTO MES_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT( SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BEAD_CODE, SAP_MATERIAL_CODE, STEEL_RING_CODE, TRIANGLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_CODE, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, SPEC_SIZE, MACHINE_CODE, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY, NEXT_MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, NEXT_MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, NEXT_MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DATA_VERSION, CREATE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE, IS_DELETE, FACTORY_CODE, COMPANY_CODE ) SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, r.BEAD_CODE, SAP_MATERIAL_CODE, STEEL_RING_CODE, TRIANGLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_CODE,MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, SPEC_SIZE, m.MACHINE_CODE, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, '1', MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, r.REMARK, #{dataVersion} DATA_VERSION, now() CREATE_DATE, r.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_DATE, r.DEL_FLAG IS_DELETE, #{factoryCode}, #{companyCode} FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT r LEFT JOIN T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m ON r.machine_id = m.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT max(TIRE_RING_SAP) SAP_MATERIAL_CODE, TIRE_RING_CODE FROM T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY TIRE_RING_CODE) p ON r.BEAD_CODE = p.TIRE_RING_CODE WHERE r.id in #{id}

SELECT schedule_date, SUM(mid_plan_qty) as day_plan_qty, SUM(night_plan_qty) as night_plan_qty, SUM(day_plan_qty) as next_day_plan_qty, SUM(stock_qty) as stock_qty FROM t_tq_schedule_result WHERE schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and INSTR(bead_code, #{beadCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 and INSTR(steel_ring_code, #{steelRingCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(triangle_glue_code, #{triangleGlueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(glue_code, #{glueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and spec_size = #{specSize} and production_status = #{productionStatus} and IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease} and INSTR(mouth_plate_code, #{mouthPlateCode}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0

SELECT SUM(night_plan_qty) as night_plan_qty FROM t_tq_schedule_result WHERE schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and INSTR(bead_code, #{beadCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 and INSTR(steel_ring_code, #{steelRingCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(triangle_glue_code, #{triangleGlueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(glue_code, #{glueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and spec_size = #{specSize} and production_status = #{productionStatus} and IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease} and INSTR(mouth_plate_code, #{mouthPlateCode}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0

SELECT IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)),0) cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and INSTR(ci.TIRE_RING_CODE, #{beadCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.BEAD_CODE, #{steelRingCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.APEX_CODE, #{triangleGlueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE, #{glueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION = #{specSize} and INSTR(ci.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE, #{mouthPlateCode}) > 0

SELECT bead_code, SUM(night_plan_qty) as lastMidPlanQty FROM t_tq_schedule_result WHERE del_flag = '0' and schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and INSTR(bead_code, #{beadCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 and INSTR(steel_ring_code, #{steelRingCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(triangle_glue_code, #{triangleGlueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(glue_code, #{glueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and spec_size = #{specSize} and production_status = #{productionStatus} and IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease} and INSTR(mouth_plate_code, #{mouthPlateCode}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
GROUP BY bead_code

SELECT ci.TIRE_RING_CODE as beadCode, IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)),0) as cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and INSTR(ci.TIRE_RING_CODE, #{beadCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.BEAD_CODE, #{steelRingCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.APEX_CODE, #{triangleGlueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE, #{glueCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION = #{specSize} and INSTR(ci.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE, #{mouthPlateCode}) > 0
GROUP BY ci.TIRE_RING_CODE
